These three headers are copied byte-for-byte from the Kotlin Native runtime dependency:
  tmp/kotlin/kotlin-native/runtime/src/utfcpp/cpp/utf8/{core,unchecked,with_replacement}.h

The Native runtime's createStringFromUTF8 uses this dependency. The C++ exception
message binding uses the same UTF-8-to-UTF-16 conversion before computing the
Native polynomial string hash. No Kotlin compiler or runtime is needed.

Copyright and license notices are preserved in each copied header. core.h and
unchecked.h carry Nemanja Trifunovic's permissive license; with_replacement.h
carries JetBrains' Apache-2.0 license. These are upstream dependency files,
not newly transliterated library source.
